turns.message: luminance is king for galaxies imo. wavelets do nothing on faint extended structure
wait why does luminance dominate over color?
Yara: human eye and the camera both have higher sensitivity in the green band; the L channel carries most of the structural detail at the cost of less spectral information. RGB is just chrominance.
